inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL upsert conditionally overwrites each duplicate-row field only when its incoming parameter is non-NULL, preserving existing values for omitted updates.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored profile registry refresh. Assignment-style INSERT supplies nullable partial updates, duplicate-key IF expressions preserve existing fields for NULL inputs while refreshing non-NULL fields, a version guard rejects stale updates, and RETURNING exposes both the conflict and insertion paths. The source parameters, schema, identifiers, and phylogeography workflow are not copied.

fixture_notes: Profile 701 starts with a legacy label, region, note, and version. The conflicting SET upsert preserves label and note because incoming values are NULL, refreshes region, and advances version from 4 to 5. Profile 702 is new and keeps its nullable note. The returned rows and final table verify both conflict and insertion behavior.
determinism_notes: Profile IDs, nullable incoming fields, version values, and final ordering are fixed; the duplicate update has one unique target per input row. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE profile_registry (profile_id INT PRIMARY KEY, display_name VARCHAR(32) NULL, region_code VARCHAR(16) NULL, profile_note VARCHAR(64) NULL, revision INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO profile_registry SET profile_id = 701, display_name = NULL, region_code = 'APAC', profile_note = NULL, revision = 5 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = IF(VALUES(display_name) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(display_name), display_name), region_code = IF(VALUES(region_code) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(region_code), region_code), profile_note = IF(VALUES(profile_note) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(profile_note), profile_note), revision = IF(VALUES(revision) > revision, VALUES(revision), revision) RETURNING profile_id, display_name, region_code, profile_note, revision

INSERT INTO profile_registry SET profile_id = 702, display_name = 'new-node', region_code = 'NA', profile_note = NULL, revision = 1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = IF(VALUES(display_name) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(display_name), display_name), region_code = IF(VALUES(region_code) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(region_code), region_code), profile_note = IF(VALUES(profile_note) IS NOT NULL, VALUES(profile_note), profile_note), revision = IF(VALUES(revision) > revision, VALUES(revision), revision) RETURNING profile_id, display_name, region_code, profile_note, revision

checks.sql: SELECT profile_id, display_name, region_code, profile_note, revision FROM profile_registry ORDER BY profile_id
